findings.text: From a standard $52$-card deck, one card is drawn. Find (a) $P(\text{king or queen})$ and (b) $P(\text{king or heart})$.
findings.problem: "card" may be used for a question

findings.text: 1. A card cannot be both a king and a queen, so the events are mutually exclusive.
findings.problem: "card" may be used for a question

findings.text: 2. A card can be both a king and a heart: the king of hearts. Subtract that overlap once.

findings.text: Useful standard-deck facts: $52$ cards, $4$ suits of $13$, $26$ red and $26$ black, $12$ face cards, and $4$ cards of each rank.
